title: HSK 2.0 Vocabulary & Grammar Implementation, Multi-Source Normalization & Curriculum Mapping
description: Establish standardized HSK 2.0 vocabulary (1,200 words) and grammar (311 points) datasets for HSK 1–4, verify multi-source provenance (Hanban 2012, DrKameleon, BLCUP Standard Course, AllSet Grammar Wiki), map against 70 existing curriculum lessons, provide dry-run importer and pre-import diff analysis, and halt at approval gate prior to database writes.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm cumulative vocabulary milestones: HSK 1 = 150, HSK 2 = 150 (cum 300), HSK 3 = 300 (cum 600), HSK 4 = 600 (cum 1,200)
Verify multi-source provenance: Hanban 2012 syllabus, DrKameleon CJKVI, BLCUP Standard Course textbooks, AllSet Chinese Grammar Wiki
Resolve and document homographs and polyphones (得, 还, 长, 只, 等, 对, 过)
Standardize 311 grammar points with formulas, Vietnamese explanations, and contextual examples
Map 70 lessons against HSK 2.0 Standard Course curriculum chapters
Implement dry-run importer with database lock and rollback snapshot utility
Zero database writes to ZhongWenHub_Dev (read-only) and ZhongWenHub_Test (gated)
Pass 8/8 automated data QA test suites and backend/frontend unit tests
Compile 5 comprehensive markdown reports in docs/hsk20/
safety_constraints: Zero database writes (Dev strictly read-only, Test gated pending explicit user approval)
No copyrighted books or audio files committed to Git repository
Do not auto-publish content or alter student XP/progress
Keep PR #16 Open/Draft; do not merge or force push
